name: CultureLens held-out connection-resolution suite (v2)
protocol: Written and labelled from the demonstration workbooks before any resolver was run on it. The file's SHA-256 was recorded in README.md before the first run. Labels are what a careful human reader would link, not what any resolver does.
entitySet: The eight demonstration workbooks in frontend/src/data/, loaded as the application loads them, plus the fixture entities below.

fixtureEntities.name: Ministry of Education
fixtureEntities.note: Creates a duplicate name across countries, as in real partner data

categories.variant: Same name with case, diacritic, dash or punctuation differences
categories.annotated: Name followed by an annotation or comment
categories.acronym-long: Acronym of four or more letters that appears in the target's name
categories.acronym-short: Acronym of three or fewer letters that appears in the target's name
categories.partial-name: Distinctive part of the name, a short form, or the name in the other language given in the entity name
categories.prose: Prose sentence that contains the target's full name
categories.abbreviation-not-in-name: Abbreviation or translation that appears in no entity name
categories.generic: Generic word or phrase that names no specific entity
categories.duplicate-name: Name shared by entities in several countries (ambiguous)
categories.not-in-dataset: Organisation that is not among the loaded entities
